steps.content: The case is a tangled mess, like a ball of yarn after a kitten's gotten to it. Contradictory testimony is one thing, but even the hard evidence doesn't lead to anything. It's giving you a headache.
Before you even realize it, you've wandered back to the crime scene.
And there she is, her disheveled head lowered, hunched in the corner with a small brush in hand, meticulously tending to Vita.
...Wait, was that leg bone called Vita? Or was it Yuta? You can't quite remember.

You walk over and crouch down beside her. She clearly notices you from the corner of her eye, but she doesn't acknowledge your presence. A neat row of maintained bones lies beside her, including the small finger bone you picked up yesterday.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Dorothy, was it? You really are beautiful... Do you remember me? We met yesterday. I'm that detective who's been tearing their hair out over this case.
The disheveled head beside you shifts slightly, but she still refuses to look up.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yesterday, during the investigation, your owner here helped me out tremendously. I can tell she's an upright person, but... I think I upset her somehow. I didn't mean to, but the fact is that I said something wrong...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And that's where you come in, sweet little bone. Could you apologize to her for me?
Forensica's hands finally pause. She glances at you from the corner of her eye before quickly looking away. Then, a strange voice escapes her throat.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: While you did mention that revolting place, causing her cortisol levels to spike... in light of your excellent appreciation for skeletal aesthetics, there's an approximately 67.4% chance she will probably, maybe, possibly... forgive you.
Her goofy act brings you genuine relief—the first you've felt since this dreary investigation began.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you, Dorothy. And thank her for me, too.
You hear a soft "hmph" from beside you. Then, silence returns to the space. The two of you crouch among the bones, only the soft bristles of the brush against the bone remain.
After another stretch of silence, Forensica speaks up.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Running into trouble?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The testimonies from everyone involved are riddled with contradictions. I need to figure out who's lying. Would you mind weighing in?
Forensica wrinkles her nose in distaste and shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: No thanks. I don't want to hear any testimonies from the living. I only trust what corpses tell me.
You let out a helpless chuckle. Fair enough. This is someone who packs a complete skeleton in her suitcase and names every single bone, after all.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's talk about something else, then. Why do you carry this skeleton around with you? I mean... Vita, Luke, Leia, and Dorothy...
Forensica's expression softens instantly, her fingers gently running over the bone in her hand.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Because they're beautiful... Each and every one of them. The curves, the texture, the color... Dorothy is the most beautiful of them all.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: This was an emergency rescue. I just saved them from a pigsty—one called the Judicial Forensic Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: I thought it'd be better than the other places. Turned out it was even worse. People there have no idea how to listen to what corpses are trying to tell them. All they do is switch off their brains and follow orders from above. Heh, they'd be better off testing livestock feed.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Anyway, for... certain reasons, I got into an argument with the dumbest pig there. The association revoked my license, but that's fine. Not like I want to work at another pigsty anyway.
She grows more animated as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: I'm going home, saving up some money, and then I'll go freelance—
She suddenly springs to her feet, brandishing the bone in her hand toward you like a wand.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Are you troubled by unexplained, corpse-related issues? Family or friends who died a suspicious death? If so, visit the StarRealm Unnatural Death Agency!
That strange burst of energy again. Should you applaud? Probably not. A smile will do.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Oh, right. What do you think of the name StarRealm Unnatural Death Agency?
She settles back down, her expression returning to its usual state as she resumes tending to the bone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Uh... Yeah, it's pretty good. Suits you well.
And finally, she puts down her work entirely, the corner of her lips curling up as she turns to face you.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: I've seen plenty of detectives. They rush to crack cases and chase headlines just so they can bask in the spotlight. They pray for the most sensational crimes possible—the dead are just stepping stones for their careers. I despise them.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: But you... you seem different...
Your lips break into a slight smile.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Really? Maybe it's because I'm just a bumbling detective. I mean, just look at how lost I am on this case. I'm nowhere close to being a star detective.
Forensica tilts her head, then picks up Dorothy and places it in your hands.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is...

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Dorothy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I know. But why are you giving me this?

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Dorothy's my lucky charm. She's been through countless cases with me, helping me find the truth again and again. I'm sure she'll help you too.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: You can use my report to find the truth. The dead never lie. Speak for her. Give her the justice she deserves.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What about you? You're not joining the investigation?

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: I... uh, let's just say there are certain... circumstances that make that impossible.
A realization strikes you like a bolt of lightning.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hold on, by rescuing, you don't mean... Did you steal this? Did they report you?
She appears a little ill at ease, but then she quickly lifts her chin in defiance.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: It was a humanitarian rescue. I merely liberated them from incompetent custodians. It's just that the human law has yet to recognize the virtue of such acts!
She hurriedly gathers her things, then shoves a box of homemade bone care supplies into your hands.

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Anyway, if you don't understand something, come find me. Just... don't let anyone know I'm involved...

steps.speaker: Forensica
steps.content: Take good care of Dorothy. I'm counting on you to find the truth.
As soon as those words leave her mouth, she's gone. Vanished without a trace.

Now, you've been left alone in this space, crouched in place with a pale finger bone in your left hand and a box of bone care supplies in your right. It's like a scene straight out of some absurd cartoon—you can't help but laugh out loud.
